speaker: john_shakespeare
text: By my troth, the windfalls are more honest than the market. Sit, Will. A player may sort apples if he can count to fourteen.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I have fourteen already, and three are soft. Grandfather says the soft ones are for the pig, and the pig is a partner.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: I said leave them for the pig. The boy has given the pig a share, which is more than the bailiff ever did for me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The skins, sir, before the apples become a policy.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: The skins are in. Six pairs. They are sheep. We asked for kid.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Send them back with the next man who goes up the town.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: No. You ordered them, in a hand the man can read, which was the mistake. You'll walk them back yourself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After Tuesday. The frame is at seven, and I am spoken for till they brace it.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: After the frame, then. Not me. If you want it carried, say carried. If you want it admired, fetch another man. This is the wrong wool.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: God's my comfort. Six pairs of sheep, for a glove that wants kid. Who has them to change, the man at the Rother end?

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: The same. He can read. He will say he sent what was written, and he will be right.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: May I see the writing?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou mayst see it, and thou mayst not mend it. The word is sheep because I wrote sheep. I was thinking of a sleeve.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: A sleeve. I taught thee to cut a glove. The rest thou hast added at great expense, and now at the price of six pairs.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: If the sheep is thicker, the glove is warmer. Judith would call that a rule, and then she would want both.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Judith is not the purchaser. You walk it on Wednesday, when the frame is up. The bundle stays on this bench till then. I am not your legs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wednesday. I'll take it myself, and I'll ask for kid, and I'll bring the sheep home if he will not change them.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Kid was the order. Sheep is what the hand wrote. The hand walks it back. That is the whole lesson, and it is not a speech.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: And you will not make a speech at his door. We are not a house that leaves its errors on another man's bench.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I'll come and count the six.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou wilt be at school, or thy mother will have the pair of us, and Richard will be glad of the quiet.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: School. The count is six, not fourteen. Fourteen was apples.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Fourteen apples, three for the pig, and a son who writes sheep when he means kid. The shop has had worse Mondays. The pig may have the soft ones. The man at the Rother end may not have our error.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wednesday, after the frame. No speech at his door. Six pairs, and the word was mine.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Then the bench keeps them till Wednesday. I am not your legs tonight either.
